factor_definitions.billing: Actual completion/release epoch minus VM creation epoch, rather than max(0,epoch-ready)+100

bridge_changes: reset history only on an actual scaling change
apply scale-out at next epoch boundary
disable controller during final queue drain
align all retained VM billing with final request completion
